entities.name: Lucayan Migration and Settlement
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Lucayan Taíno peoples migrated northward from Hispaniola and Cuba, settling across the Bahamian archipelago. They established villages, developed agriculture including cassava cultivation, and created extensive inter-island trade networks.
